reviews.x: No damage, there is a protective film on the outside,The box is very neatly arranged and has a shelf life of two years. The use feeling is very good, recommended.

I got this for my cellphone to desinfect them after getting home from work because my daughter play with my phone and now with covid-19 we have to be more careful. They do the job and that's what I'm looking for . They are not to moistened  and is great because you want to clean your lens,phone,camera not give a shower.  This wipes is only alcohol with water and to much could damage your device.  Recommendation Don't use wipes for sunglasses, it could damage them. Use better warm water and soap
I use it to clean my glasses, phones screens and it work perfectly not to mention that it's worth its package size
Works really nice. No streaks. No need to use dry cloth after using these.  I would recommend highly.

reviews.t: The product was fine...  I mistakenly submitted bad feedback for the seller.
reviews.x: The product and the seller are fine.  I wrote negative feedback for a vendor that was bad, and only after submitting it did I notice that I gave the feedback to the wrong seller.  I will correct the error if Amazon will let me, but I wanted to post this to tell others about the mistake.  Good seller.  Good product.
I used it once from my colleague ,its cleaning ability is much better than what I bought before so I bought it.

reviews.t: good for on the go alcohol wipes
reviews.x: I bought these at the start of the pandemic to carry with me when out and about. They are a good size to wipe your hands as well as other small surfaces. I make sure I have some where ever I go and have used them for my glasses as well.

These lens cleaning wipes are individually wrapped and very convenient. I bought them for new eye glasses that I didn’t want to damage by using improper cleaning products. They work great on the glasses, but also work great for cell phone, computer screens, and tv screens. Very economical - the box will last a very long time. I will buy them again after I use these. Easy to take when traveling, too.
To my amazement,after I wiped the glasses with it, I can also uese also use it to wipe two phones.it is also wiped clean,it's great.

I purchased these wipes back in June based on reviews and thought they were going to be great. I'm not happy with them. They leave streaks on the lens of my eye glasses. I've been using them as it wasn't worth the hassle of returning them and I wasn't going to waste the money I spent on them by throwing them in the trash.

These are great, used them on glasses. If you have a problem with streaks you should let the wipe air out for a second. Evaporate a little bit of the moisture and then you're good. If you do get streaks just go over it a second time with a different clean section of the wipe and the streaks will go away.

These are truly excellent cleaning wipes. I use them constantly for eyeglasses, laptop screens, phone screens, etc. They have the perfect amount of cleaning solution to get the job done, but dry quickly with no streaking. Exceeds expectations in terms of value for the $.

reviews.t: Great product; easy to carry and use to keep all types of lens clean and clear.
reviews.x: Great product; easy to carry and use to keep all types of lens clean and clear.  I use these on eye glasses, camera lens, binoculars and computer screens.  I carry these with me when I travel because they are quick and easy to use.

I like that the wipes are large enough that you don’t have to worry about getting your fingers on the lenses. Basically, individually wrapped wipes soaked in isopropyl alcohol. Great for removing smudges from daily use.

These wipes definitely do the job on getting my glasses cleaned especially when my little one leaves his little finger prints on my lenses. I have been looking for this type of wipes for awhile. Im glad I found these.

reviews.t: Like these the best of all brands I’ve tried
reviews.x: I have tried several brands and these are not too wet so as not to leave streaks and not too dry which doesn’t clean them at all, just perfect👍🏻
Convenient but some wipes dry out very quickly barely allowing me time to get to the second lense
Haha. I bought them got to use two and lost them somewhere in my house🙄
Great! They work very well. Arrived on time. Excellent product!

reviews.t: Many of the wipes were dry
reviews.x: Initially I was happy with this product and it seemed to work well, but then I found that the bulk of the wipes were dry and I had to use 2 or more to clean my glasses. I don't know if I received old stock or whether this is typical of this product since this is the first time that I've purchased them. The wipes that I used to purchase from a local retailer were moist enough to clean 2 pairs of glasses, while I can barely get one lens clean with these. I definitely do not recommend this product.

I like the fact that you can separate these and keep them in use after one wipe down. The purpose I was looking for in these was to solve my constant glasses cleaning problem. I find my prescription glasses to get very dirty very easily with smudges. These solved that issue and more with allowing me to wipe down my phone and glasses with one wipe. The downside would be the wipes causing more streakiness, but this only happens when the wipe is too saturated to start off with.

reviews.t: Does Not Work As Well As Others
reviews.x: The wipes feel a little on the dry side and doesn't work as well as other wipes I have tried in the past. With these wipes, they leave streaks and you have to constantly keep wiping to try to rid of the streaks and clean your computer screen and glasses. The wipes "cleaning agent" also don't fade away immediately like other wipes do. Instead, it lingers for about 10 seconds give or take, versus other wipes, they begin to fade almost immediately.

One wipe per lens before it dries out. 8 wipes on my laptop, which is not a touchscreen, because they kept drying out. Serious streaks on my cell phones. My glasses are still as streaky as they were before I used them. The ingredients are: water, isopropyl alcohol which means they are mostly water (ingredients must always be listed in order of majority to minority) and just enough rubbing alcohol to dry them out despite the wrapping.

So not sure if all wipes have the same issue from being in a box for a long time, but the first two were dry very little liquide. These were were OK, then the third wipe  was a bit better. For now, I say if you are in a pinch and budget, then these would work, but I rather pay little more for a better wipe. I will finish these and update my review if they improve. But I doubt I would order them again.

I thought these were the same lens cleaners I usually order, which are the Zeiss lens cleaners. They looked the same. These leave a film on my glasses and I'm not a fan. Going to end up tossing them and ordering the right lens cleaners.

claims.text: Reviewers widely say the wipes clean effectively, working well on glasses, phone screens, and other lenses.
Many reviewers report the wipes leave no streaks and dry quickly.
Several reviewers praise the individually wrapped, portable packaging and good value for the price.
A few reviewers mention streak issues, with one dissatisfied and another offering a tip to avoid them.
Some reviewers note the wipes are not overly moistened, which they find suitable for cleaning.
